No arrows, connecting lines, panel letters or numeric axis values are visible; the boxes and icon are arranged around the center without connectors.

visual.general_description: Three stacked 12-lead ECG panels (A, B, C) on gray grid.
visual.detailed_description: Three vertically stacked ECG panels labelled A, B and C on gray grid. Panel A: A bold letter A is at the upper left of a gray-grid ECG block arranged in four columns and three rows: lead labels I, II, III (column 1), aVR, aVL, aVF (column 2), V1, V2, V3 (column 3) and V4, V5, V6 (column 4). Each lead segment shows widely spaced repeated complexes; lead II and III segments have the tallest deflections and the V segments are smaller. No printed scale text, circle, arrow or numeric value is visible in this panel. Panel B: A bold letter B is near the upper left of a gray-grid ECG block with twelve stacked full-width rows labelled I, II, III, aVR, aVL, aVF, V1, V2, V3, V4, V5, V6 down the left edge. Rows II, III, aVR, aVF and V1 to V6 show continuous, closely spaced oscillating deflections across the full width; row I and row aVL show lower-amplitude irregular wiggles. A single larger vertical deflection crosses most rows at about one fifth of the width from the left. A bracket-shaped calibration mark is at the left beside the V1 row. Printed text at the lower left reads as "25 mm/s 10 mm/mV" and at the lower right as "Passa-baixo 40 Hz, AC 50H", the right end of which is cut at the image edge. No circle or other marking is visible on the tracing. Panel C: A bold letter C is at the upper left of a gray-grid ECG block arranged in four columns and three rows with the same lead labels as panel A: I, II, III, aVR, aVL, aVF, V1 to V6. Each lead segment shows closely spaced repeated complexes; the lead II and III segments begin with a rising baseline at the left edge. No printed scale text, circle, arrow or numeric value is visible in this panel.
